stat_curve._doc: Rank-cast, not a linear multiply. Each unit's civ2 value is placed by its RANK POSITION within the civ2 distribution, then re-cast onto the CTP2 target range anchored on min/median/max. The warp is smoothstep w=p^2(3-2p): its gradient rises to a peak at the midpoint then decays, so power climbs steeply at the bottom and saturates at the top instead of running away. target = [min, median, max].
stat_curve._source_outlier_cutoff: civ2 values >= this are excluded when measuring the SOURCE distribution, so one broken row cannot stretch the scale for everyone. Infernal Device is 99a at cost 480 -- 6.6x the next attack for a seventh of the price. It is still cast, it just no longer defines the maximum.
stat_curve._target_provenance: attack/defense/firepower are stock CTP2's own min/median/max, so no value lands outside a range the engine already ships. HP has NO stock spread to match -- stock is flat 10 on all 74 units -- so its target preserves the SOURCE ratios instead: civ2 hp runs 1/2/6, and 10/20/60 is that same 1x/2x/6x with the floor left at today's universal value so no unit loses HP.

unit_roles._doc_vessels: Artifact VESSELS. Never buildable in any city by any tribe -- they are FOUND, or left behind when a genie is defeated. The generator emits an unconditional block for these in mod_CanCityBuildUnit, ahead of the per-sphere walls, so the rule does not depend on a vessel having a sphere.

tips_string_overrides.STATUSBAR_TILEIMP_SELECT_ROAD2_BUTTON: Enchanted Roads can be placed on any land tile.
